_meta.athlete: 65 kg male, 175 cm, 1-month beginner, Delhi NCR
_meta.basis: Bench ~40 kg (bar 20 + 10/side) and Squat ~40 kg (bar 20 + 10/side) are confirmed. Leg days were skipped more than upper days in month 1, so leg loads are deliberately conservative. Everything else is a beginner estimate — the first session on each exercise is a 'find your weight' session: adjust ± until the last 2 reps of the target feel hard with clean form.
_meta.kgMeaning: barbell/machine/cable = total load; dumbbell = per hand; assisted = assistance weight
_meta.progressionRule: All sets at repMax with clean form -> add step next session. Any set below repMin two sessions in a row at the same kg -> minus one step.

monday-barbell-back-squat.note: bar 20 + 10/side. Depth: hip crease at knee level. Ramp-up: empty bar x8, 30 x5, then working sets.

monday-romanian-deadlift-rdl.note: bar 20 + 5/side. Back flat is the only rule; go up only when the video shows a flat back.

monday-leg-press.note: plates on sled, 20/side. If it is a stack machine start at ~60.

monday-standing-calf-raise.note: 1 s pause at top, full stretch at bottom.

monday-plank-side-plank.note: Plank 3 x 30 s; side plank 2 x 20 s per side (log side plank as a note, not a set).

tuesday-cable-lateral-raise.note: per side, lowest plate. Light and clean beats heavy and swung.

tuesday-overhead-db-triceps-extension.note: one dumbbell held in both hands.

wednesday-assisted-pull-up-close-grip-la.note: assistance weight — progression REDUCES it; goal 0 (first unassisted pull-up) by month 3. If using close-grip pulldown instead: machine, 30 kg, step +5.

wednesday-chest-supported-row.note: per hand. Machine row: 30 kg, step 5.

wednesday-face-pull.note: elbows high, pull the rope apart. If it turns into a row, the weight is too heavy.

thursday-leg-press-heavy-day.note: Monday's leg press + 10. Same range of motion, no knee lockout.

thursday-walking-lunges.note: reps are per leg. Bodyweight first, then 5 kg per hand once 3 x 12 per leg is clean.

thursday-hanging-knee-raise.note: progress reps only; at 3 x 15 clean, switch to straight-leg raises.

thursday-farmer-s-carry.note: per hand; reps = steps. Walk tall, shoulders back.

friday-barbell-bench-press.note: bar 20 + 10/side. +2.5 total needs 1.25 kg plates; if the gym has none, the app rounds to +5. Spotter on set 3.

friday-lat-pulldown.note: pull with the elbows, chest up, 1 s squeeze. If it is felt in the arms/triceps, drop one plate.
